prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1415; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for rear-end collision. Insured reports being stopped at a red light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Police report requested. No immediate injuries reported at scene by insured.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received requesting that all further contact be directed to counsel's office. Claimant reports neck strain and stiffness following the impact. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos of both vehicles. Rear bumper damage to insured vehicle with secondary damage to the cargo area. Estimate prepared and submitted for repair. Liability appears clear based on the rear-impact pattern and statements taken so far.

Entry 4: Spoke with counsel's office regarding treatment status. Claimant attending physical therapy twice weekly for cervical strain. Treating physician records requested. Counsel indicated a settlement demand will follow once treatment concludes.

Entry 5: Received medical records summary confirming diagnosis of cervical strain with limited range of motion. No fractures or imaging findings of concern noted. File flagged for supervisor review ahead of settlement evaluation. Follow-up scheduled to confirm treatment completion.
